commons.title: Southern Tutchone board game.jpg
commons.description: Dánän Keänje - Our Land Speaks - a board game that helps players learn Southern Tutchone, a Yukon First Nation language.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically identifies a Southern Tutchone language-learning board game, and the visible board game is a cultural educational object.

commons.title: Stop sign in Southern Tutchone.JPG
commons.description: Nlan, a Southern Tutchone word, added to stop signs in the McIntyre subdivision of Whitehorse. It means, “stop that now,” as there is no exact translation. This initiative is to promote the Southern Tutchone language.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically links the stop sign to Southern Tutchone language promotion, and the visible sign displays the Southern Tutchone word “Nlan.”
